# Emmys 2025: The Studio, The Pitt And Adolescence Win Big —See Full List By Ryan Schwartz Sept. 14, 2025 11:10 pm EST
 Emmys 2025: Winners List Courtesy of CBS The 77th Primetime Emmy Awards were presented Sunday, in a CBS ceremony hosted by Nate Bargatze . Heading into the 2025 Emmys, Apple TV+'s*Severance*led the drama field with 27 nominations, but ultimately claimed eight wins —including Outstanding Lead Actress (Britt Lower) and Outstanding Supporting Actor (Tramell Tillman). HBO Max's*The Pitt*converted five out of 13 nominations, including Outstanding Drama, Outstanding Lead Actor (Noah Wyle) and Outstanding Supporting Actress (Katherine LaNasa). In the comedy race, Apple TV+'s*The Studio*led the pack with 23 nominations —a record for a first-year comedy. It then ... Outstanding Lead Actor (Seth Rogen). In the limited series field, Netflix's*Adolescence*reigned supreme with eight wins, including Outstanding Limited ... Actress (Erin Doherty).
